findings.title: Keep the UI bundle's interpolation format
findings.body: This React UI bundle uses i18next-style `{{0}}` interpolation; the previous value for this key used that syntax. The new Java `MessageFormat` placeholders (`{0}`, `{1}`, `{2,choice,...}`) are not expanded by the UI, so users seeing this validation error will get literal placeholders instead of the attribute name, limits, and pluralized value count.

findings.title: Keep the admin UI bundle's interpolation format
findings.body: This React UI bundle uses i18next-style `{{0}}` interpolation; the previous value for this key used that syntax. The new Java `MessageFormat` placeholders (`{0}`, `{1}`, `{2,choice,...}`) are not expanded by the UI, so users seeing this validation error will get literal placeholders instead of the attribute name, limits, and pluralized value count.

findings.title: Restore Lithuanian text for TOTP setup
findings.body: This replacement sentence is Italian (`Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:`), not Lithuanian, so Lithuanian users see an untranslated TOTP setup instruction. The corresponding `loginTotpStep1` in `themes/src/main/resources-community/theme/base/login/messages/messages_lt.properties` has the same Italian text and should be corrected as well.

findings.title: Use Simplified Chinese in the zh_CN message
findings.body: This replacement uses Traditional Chinese forms such as `手機`, `安裝`, and `應用程式` in the `zh_CN` resource, whose surrounding text is Simplified Chinese. The account TOTP setup flow will therefore switch scripts mid-message; use Simplified Chinese wording here.
